purpose: Define the only path by which a Learning Engine candidate can become an applied ONSURE program change.

problem_statement.observed_gap: Learning candidates and validation requests can exist while applied_count remains zero.
root_cause: Learning Engine is intentionally prohibited from opening gates.
Validator PASS Receipt has not been converted into a Promotion Receipt.
No Apply Commit or active registry selector is required by the previous contracts.
Applied count definition was not explicit enough to distinguish candidate storage from actual adoption.
problem_statement.correction: Add an explicit Candidate to Applied pipeline, first applied case protocol, and applied-count accounting rules.

application_classes.description: Apply a learned fixture, rubric, validator rule, policy rule, or harness improvement inside ONSURE validation assets.
Apply a learned change to ONSURE executable source code.
Apply a learned change to a target product such as ORUDA.
application_classes.reason: Target adapters are deferred until ONSURE Core can prove its own promotion path.

must_count_only_when: active program, validation pack, or registry selector actually references the promoted artifact
must_not_count_when: candidate only exists in learning queue
validation request exists but no PASS Receipt
PASS Receipt exists but no Promotion Approval
promotion approved but artifact is not active
PR is open but not merged or registry selector not updated
non-final candidate is adopted only inside an experiment

first_applied_case_mvp.success_condition: One learned candidate is independently validated twice, promoted, merged or activated, post-apply verified, and counted as APPLIED_LOCKED.
